name: s3GenerateURI
description: Builds a non-signed, canonical URI for an S3 (or S3-compatible) object. No network call is made. style may be virtualhost (default) or path; secure controls the https/http scheme; host overrides the endpoint (e.g. for Cloudflare R2 or MinIO).

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket.

params.name: object
params.description: The object key. When omitted, a bucket-level URI is returned.

params.name: style
params.description: Addressing style: virtualhost (bucket as subdomain, default) or path (bucket as first path segment).

params.name: secure
params.description: Whether to use https (true, default) or http.

params.name: host
params.description: Endpoint host to use instead of the default AWS endpoint (e.g. an R2 or MinIO host).

examples.title: Generate a canonical object URI
examples.description: Virtual-host style against the default endpoint.

examples.title: Path-style URI for a custom endpoint
examples.description: Useful for providers that do not serve bucket subdomains.
